judged_text: The conditional was inverted: the old `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` (slug written only when billing is disabled) became `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})` (slug written only when billing is enabled), and the metadata.requestedSlug condition was flipped the same way. Self-hosted installs (IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED=false) now create organizations with no slug and no requestedSlug, breaking org URLs and later slug resolution; on billing-enabled deployments the slug is now persisted at creation time before payment, breaking the paywall flow where the slug was only requested in metadata and assigned after checkout.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts`, the diff changes `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, which is an inversion: when `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED` is false, `slug` is no longer written at creation time. The `requestedSlug` metadata conditional is *not* inverted (it remains gated on `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED`), but the slug inversion alone is a real behavior change that can result in organizations being created without a `slug` in the non-team-billing case.
